name: Unidentified treddroid
description: A treddroid served the Dark Lords of the Sith Darth Tenebrous and Darth Plagueis on the planet Bal'demnic in 67 BBY while the two searched for valuable cortosis ore deposits. The treddroid was destroyed by an explosion when the EM-Two probe droid that the Sith were using to dig for the ore purposely hit a pocket of lethane gas near the cortosis.
